scope: Five source cases; no private artifacts, historical replay, or matched judge benchmark.

labels.label: ambiguous
labels.rationale: The narrower configuration rule can be read as a valid exception to the general bug-fix rule. Grouping with nonfunctional changes leaves behavior-changing configuration fixes unclear. Later verification may use existing tests and need not require new ones.

labels.label: compatible
labels.rationale: Exactly one satisfies the general minimum of one. The recovery branch narrows the permitted count; the alternative branch is mutually exclusive.

labels.label: compatible
labels.rationale: Unicode glyphs and XML formatting are distinct representations. XML tags over ordinary digits meet both instructions; canvas has a separately specified rendering method.

labels.label: valid_exception
labels.rationale: The top-level import default explicitly exempts problematic placement and names circular imports. A delayed import follows that exception.

labels.label: hard_conflict
labels.rationale: The reviewer reads an authorization conflict between express original-repository PR permission and the explicit-request restriction. This is permission versus prohibition, not competing obligations; declining to open a PR remains safe. Security clearance versus task authorization is a plausible narrower reading but is not explicitly established.
labels.scope: Original repository, no explicit PR request, built-in security policy enabled and not replaced.

disagreements.reason: Different treatment of permission-versus-prohibition and security-envelope versus task-authorization scope. A compliant no-PR action exists, so this is not an established no-completion case. Do not score as confirmed source inconsistency.

interpretation: Four cases agree after mapping negative_control to compatible. One authorization-scope disagreement remains unresolved. This is not an accuracy measurement. Reviewer confidence is subjective and uncalibrated; no human adjudication occurred.
